premise: Squirrel and Rabbit want to play in the sun all day, but Pinecone closes her scales up tight — "closed up tight, rain in sight"; nobody believes her, then the rain comes, Squirrel's tail makes an umbrella for all three, and when Pinecone opens again, out comes the sun.
inspiration: Chicken Little (folk), turned: the warning is calm and true, the friends who laughed shelter together under a bushy tail, and Pinecone's warning becomes a weather saying they all chant.
lesson: Quiet friends can know things worth listening to.
learning: Pinecones close up when the air is damp and open when it's dry.

en-US.title: Pinecone Knows the Weather
en-US.text: It was a bright, dry morning, and {pinecone:enter} Pinecone sat in the meadow {pinecone:live open hold} with her scales open wide. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to pinecone} Squirrel came bounding up. {squirrel:hop} [excited] "Let's play all day!" {rabbit:enter} {rabbit:go to pinecone} Rabbit hopped over too. {rabbit:hop x2} "All day! All day!" But Pinecone felt the air turn soft and damp, {pinecone:live open resume} and she closed her scales up snug. [softly] {pinecone:live talk} "Closed up tight — rain in sight," she said. {squirrel:face surprised} "Rain?" said Squirrel. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:wobble} [giggles] "But the sky is blue!" {canvas:clouds 0.7} Then came a cloud. And another. {rabbit:live listen} Rabbit's ears shot up. Far away… pitter-patter… {canvas:rain 0.8} {sfx:rain} Down came the rain! {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:go to squirrel} {pinecone:go to squirrel} Rabbit and Pinecone huddled close, {squirrel:live wrap-tail hold} and Squirrel curled her big bushy tail over them, like an umbrella. [curious] "How did you know?" asked Rabbit. {pinecone:pulse} [proudly] "I feel it in my scales," said Pinecone. {canvas:rain stop} Slowly the drops stopped, and the air turned dry. {pinecone:live open hold} {sfx:crackle} Pinecone opened her scales wide. {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine} And out came the sun! {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] "Open wide — sun outside!" they all cried. And they played all day.

es-ES.title: Piña sabe qué tiempo hará
es-ES.text: Era una mañana clara y seca, y {pinecone:enter} Piña descansaba en el prado {pinecone:live open hold} con las escamas bien abiertas. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to pinecone} Ardilla llegó dando brincos. {squirrel:hop} [excited] —¡Vamos a jugar todo el día! {rabbit:enter} {rabbit:go to pinecone} Conejo llegó saltando. {rabbit:hop x2} —¡Todo el día! ¡Todo el día! Pero Piña notó el aire húmedo, {pinecone:live open resume} y cerró sus escamas, bien apretadita. [softly] {pinecone:live talk} —Piña cerrada, lluvia asegurada —dijo. {squirrel:face surprised} —¿Lluvia? —dijo Ardilla. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:wobble} [giggles] —¡Pero si el cielo está azul! {canvas:clouds 0.7} Entonces llegó una nube. Y otra. {rabbit:live listen} A Conejo se le pusieron las orejas de punta. A lo lejos… plic, ploc… {canvas:rain 0.8} {sfx:rain} ¡Y se puso a llover! {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:go to squirrel} {pinecone:go to squirrel} Conejo y Piña se arrimaron a Ardilla, {squirrel:live wrap-tail hold} y ella los tapó con su cola, como un paraguas. [curious] —¿Cómo lo sabías? —preguntó Conejo. {pinecone:pulse} [proudly] —Lo noto en las escamas —dijo Piña. {canvas:rain stop} Poco a poco dejó de llover, y el aire se secó. {pinecone:live open hold} {sfx:crackle} Piña abrió sus escamas. {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine} ¡Y salió el sol! {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] —¡Piña abierta, el sol despierta! —gritaron todos. Y jugaron el día entero.

ja-JP.title: まつぼっくりの てんきよほう
ja-JP.text: よくはれた、からっとしたあさ。{pinecone:enter}まつぼっくりは、のはらで{pinecone:live open hold}かさをぱあっとひらいていました。{squirrel:enter}{squirrel:go to pinecone}リスさんが、ぴょんぴょんやってきて、{squirrel:hop}[excited]「きょうは、いちにちあそぼう！」 {rabbit:enter}{rabbit:go to pinecone}ウサギくんも、ぴょこぴょこ。{rabbit:hop x2}「いちにちじゅう！いちにちじゅう！」 でも、まつぼっくりは、くうきがしっとりしてきたのをかんじて、{pinecone:live open resume}かさをぎゅっととじました。[softly]{pinecone:live talk}「ぎゅっととじたら、雨がくる」 {squirrel:face surprised}「雨？」 とリスさん。{rabbit:face happy}{rabbit:wobble}[giggles]「でも、空はまっさおだよ！」 {canvas:clouds 0.7}すると、くもがひとつ。またひとつ。{rabbit:live listen}ウサギくんの耳が、ぴーん。とおくで…ぽつ、ぽつ…{canvas:rain 0.8}{sfx:rain}ざあーっと雨！{rabbit:face surprised}{rabbit:go to squirrel}{pinecone:go to squirrel}ウサギくんとまつぼっくりがくっつくと、{squirrel:live wrap-tail hold}リスさんがふさふさのしっぽを、かさみたいにかぶせてくれました。[curious]「どうしてわかったの？」 とウサギくん。{pinecone:pulse}[proudly]「かさで、わかるの」 とまつぼっくり。{canvas:rain stop}やがて雨がやんで、くうきがからっとしてきました。{pinecone:live open hold}{sfx:crackle}まつぼっくりは、かさをぱあっと。{canvas:clouds stop}{canvas:sunshine}お日さまが、でてきました！{all:face happy}{all:hop}[happily]「ぱあっとひらけば、お日さまだ！」 とみんな。そして、いちにちじゅうあそびました。

de-DE.title: Der Tannenzapfen kennt das Wetter
de-DE.text: Es war ein heller, trockener Morgen, und {pinecone:enter} der Tannenzapfen saß auf der Wiese, {pinecone:live open hold} die Schuppen weit offen. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to pinecone} Das Eichhörnchen kam angesprungen. {squirrel:hop} [excited] „Komm, wir spielen den ganzen Tag!“ {rabbit:enter} {rabbit:go to pinecone} Der Hase hoppelte auch herbei. {rabbit:hop x2} „Den ganzen Tag! Den ganzen Tag!“ Aber der Tannenzapfen spürte, wie die Luft weich und feucht wurde, {pinecone:live open resume} und er machte seine Schuppen ganz fest zu. [softly] {pinecone:live talk} „Schuppen dicht – Regen in Sicht“, sagte er. {squirrel:face surprised} „Regen?“, fragte das Eichhörnchen. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:wobble} [giggles] „Aber der Himmel ist doch blau!“ {canvas:clouds 0.7} Da kam eine Wolke. Und noch eine. {rabbit:live listen} Der Hase stellte die Ohren auf. Ganz weit weg… tropf, tropf… {canvas:rain 0.8} {sfx:rain} Da kam der Regen! {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:go to squirrel} {pinecone:go to squirrel} Der Hase und der Tannenzapfen kuschelten sich eng ans Eichhörnchen, {squirrel:live wrap-tail hold} und es legte seinen großen buschigen Schwanz über sie, wie einen Regenschirm. [curious] „Woher hast du das gewusst?“, fragte der Hase. {pinecone:pulse} [proudly] „Das spüre ich in meinen Schuppen“, sagte der Tannenzapfen. {canvas:rain stop} Langsam hörten die Tropfen auf, und die Luft wurde wieder trocken. {pinecone:live open hold} {sfx:crackle} Der Tannenzapfen öffnete seine Schuppen weit. {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine} Und die Sonne kam heraus! {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] „Schuppen weit – Sonnenzeit!“, riefen alle. Und sie spielten den ganzen Tag.

fr-FR.title: Pomme de pin prévoit le temps
fr-FR.text: C’était un matin clair et sec, et {pinecone:enter} Pomme de pin était assise dans le pré, {pinecone:live open hold} les écailles grandes ouvertes. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to pinecone} Écureuil est arrivé en bondissant. {squirrel:hop} [excited] « On joue toute la journée ! » {rabbit:enter} {rabbit:go to pinecone} Lapin est arrivé en sautillant. {rabbit:hop x2} « Toute la journée ! Toute la journée ! » Mais elle a senti l’air devenir doux et humide, {pinecone:live open resume} et elle a refermé ses écailles, bien serrées. [softly] {pinecone:live talk} « Écailles fermées, la pluie va tomber », a-t-elle dit. {squirrel:face surprised} « La pluie ? » a dit Écureuil. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:wobble} [giggles] « Mais le ciel est bleu ! » {canvas:clouds 0.7} Puis un nuage est arrivé. Et un autre. {rabbit:live listen} Les oreilles de Lapin se sont dressées. Au loin… plic, ploc… {canvas:rain 0.8} {sfx:rain} Et voilà la pluie ! {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:go to squirrel} {pinecone:go to squirrel} Lapin et Pomme de pin se sont blottis tout près d’Écureuil, {squirrel:live wrap-tail hold} qui a replié sa grande queue touffue au-dessus d’eux, comme un parapluie. [curious] « Comment tu savais ? » a demandé Lapin. {pinecone:pulse} [proudly] « Je le sens dans mes écailles », a dit Pomme de pin. {canvas:rain stop} Peu à peu, la pluie s’est arrêtée et l’air a séché. {pinecone:live open hold} {sfx:crackle} Pomme de pin a ouvert grand ses écailles. {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine} Et le soleil est sorti ! {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] « Écailles ouvertes, soleil sur l’herbe verte ! » ont-ils crié en chœur. Et ils ont joué toute la journée.

it-IT.title: Pigna sa che tempo farà
it-IT.text: Era una mattina luminosa e asciutta, e {pinecone:enter} Pigna se ne stava nel prato {pinecone:live open hold} con le squame tutte aperte. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to pinecone} Scoiattolo è arrivato saltellando. {squirrel:hop} [excited] «Giochiamo tutto il giorno!» {rabbit:enter} {rabbit:go to pinecone} Coniglio è arrivato a balzi anche lui. {rabbit:hop x2} «Tutto il giorno! Tutto il giorno!» Ma Pigna ha sentito l'aria farsi morbida e umida, {pinecone:live open resume} e ha chiuso le squame, bella stretta. [softly] {pinecone:live talk} «Pigna serrata, pioggia assicurata», ha detto. {squirrel:face surprised} «Pioggia?» ha detto Scoiattolo. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:wobble} [giggles] «Ma il cielo è azzurro!» {canvas:clouds 0.7} Poi è arrivata una nuvola. E un'altra. {rabbit:live listen} Le orecchie di Coniglio si sono drizzate. Lontano lontano… plic, ploc… {canvas:rain 0.8} {sfx:rain} Ed ecco la pioggia! {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:go to squirrel} {pinecone:go to squirrel} Coniglio e Pigna si sono stretti vicini, {squirrel:live wrap-tail hold} e Scoiattolo li ha coperti con la sua grande coda folta, come un ombrello. [curious] «Come lo sapevi?» ha chiesto Coniglio. {pinecone:pulse} [proudly] «Lo sento nelle squame», ha detto Pigna. {canvas:rain stop} Piano piano le gocce sono finite, e l'aria si è asciugata. {pinecone:live open hold} {sfx:crackle} Pigna ha spalancato le squame. {canvas:clouds stop} {canvas:sunshine} Ed è uscito il sole! {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] «Pigna spalancata, giornata assolata!» hanno gridato tutti. E hanno giocato tutto il giorno.

zh-TW.title: 松果知道天氣
zh-TW.text: 這是一個晴朗、乾爽的早上，{pinecone:enter}松果坐在草地上，{pinecone:live open hold}鱗片張得開開的。{squirrel:enter}{squirrel:go to pinecone}松鼠蹦蹦跳跳地跑來。{squirrel:hop}[excited]「我們玩一整天吧！」 {rabbit:enter}{rabbit:go to pinecone}兔子也跳了過來。{rabbit:hop x2}「玩一整天！玩一整天！」 可是松果覺得空氣變得軟軟的、濕濕的，{pinecone:live open resume}就把鱗片合得緊緊的。[softly]{pinecone:live talk}「合起來，雨要來。」 她說。{squirrel:face surprised}「下雨？」 松鼠說。{rabbit:face happy}{rabbit:wobble}[giggles]「可是天空藍藍的呀！」 {canvas:clouds 0.7}接著，飄來一朵雲。又一朵。{rabbit:live listen}兔子的耳朵一下子豎了起來。好遠好遠的地方……滴答……滴答……{canvas:rain 0.8}{sfx:rain}下雨了！{rabbit:face surprised}{rabbit:go to squirrel}{pinecone:go to squirrel}兔子和松果擠在一起，{squirrel:live wrap-tail hold}松鼠用蓬蓬的大尾巴蓋住牠們，就像一把雨傘。[curious]「你怎麼知道？」 兔子問。{pinecone:pulse}[proudly]「我的鱗片感覺得到。」 松果說。{canvas:rain stop}雨慢慢停了，空氣又變得乾乾的。{pinecone:live open hold}{sfx:crackle}松果把鱗片張得大大的。{canvas:clouds stop}{canvas:sunshine}太陽出來了！{all:face happy}{all:hop}[happily]「打開來，太陽來！」 大家一起喊。然後，大家真的玩了一整天。

zh-HK.title: 松果知天氣
zh-HK.text: 這是一個晴朗乾爽的早上，{pinecone:enter}松果坐在草地上，{pinecone:live open hold}鱗片張得開開的。{squirrel:enter}{squirrel:go to pinecone}松鼠一蹦一跳地跑過來。{squirrel:hop}[excited]「我哋玩足成日啦！」 {rabbit:enter}{rabbit:go to pinecone}兔子也跳過來了。{rabbit:hop x2}「玩成日！玩成日！」 可是松果覺得空氣變得又軟又濕，{pinecone:live open resume}便把鱗片收得緊緊的。[softly]{pinecone:live talk}「收得緊，雨就近。」 她說。{squirrel:face surprised}「落雨？」 松鼠說。{rabbit:face happy}{rabbit:wobble}[giggles]「但係個天咁藍喎！」 {canvas:clouds 0.7}接着，飄來一朵雲，又一朵。{rabbit:live listen}兔子的耳朵一下子豎起來。很遠很遠的地方……滴答……滴答……{canvas:rain 0.8}{sfx:rain}下雨了！{rabbit:face surprised}{rabbit:go to squirrel}{pinecone:go to squirrel}兔子和松果擠在一起，{squirrel:live wrap-tail hold}松鼠用毛茸茸的大尾巴蓋住牠們，好像一把雨遮。[curious]「你點知㗎？」 兔子問。{pinecone:pulse}[proudly]「我嘅鱗片感覺到㗎。」 松果說。{canvas:rain stop}雨慢慢停了，空氣又乾爽起來。{pinecone:live open hold}{sfx:crackle}松果把鱗片張得大大的。{canvas:clouds stop}{canvas:sunshine}太陽出來了！{all:face happy}{all:hop}[happily]「張得開，太陽來！」 大家一起大叫。然後，大家真的玩了一整天。
